Terms of Service
Version 1.0 · May 2026 · mytaxfly.com
1. Acceptance

By using MyTaxFly you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy.

2. Service Description

MyTaxFly is an AI-powered bookkeeping tool for US LLC founders. It allows you to categorize transactions, generate reports, and access an AI tax assistant.

3. Not Tax Advice
Important: MyTaxFly is not a licensed tax advisor. Nothing on this platform constitutes tax, legal, or financial advice. Always consult a qualified CPA.
4. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old and have legal capacity to enter into a binding agreement.

5. Payment & Subscriptions

Paid plans are charged monthly in USD via Stripe. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled. Contact support@mytaxfly.com within 14 days for billing disputes.

6. Acceptable Use

You may not use MyTaxFly to violate laws, upload fraudulent documents, or facilitate tax fraud or money laundering.

7. Limitation of Liability

MyTaxFly is not liable for errors in AI-generated outputs, tax penalties, or unauthorized account access. Total liability shall not exceed amounts paid in the 3 months preceding any claim.

8. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by Delaware law. EU users retain rights under applicable EU consumer protection law.

9. Contact
MyTaxFly Supportsupport@mytaxfly.com · www.mytaxfly.com

Privacy Policy
Version 1.0 · May 2026 · GDPR & CCPA Compliant · mytaxfly.com
1. Data Controller
MyTaxFlyprivacy@mytaxfly.com · www.mytaxfly.com
2. Data We Collect
  • Account data: name, email, password (hashed)
  • Business data: LLC name, transaction data you enter
  • Financial documents you upload
  • Payment data via Stripe (we never store card numbers)
  • Usage data: log files, IP address, browser type
3. How We Use Your Data
  • To provide AI analysis and categorization of your transactions
  • To process subscription payments via Stripe
  • To send service-related communications
  • To comply with legal obligations
4. AI Processing
Important: Your financial data is never used to train AI models. Document content is sent to Anthropic solely to provide the analysis service.
5. Third Parties
  • Anthropic — AI processing (anthropic.com/privacy)
  • Stripe — Payments (stripe.com/privacy)
  • Vercel — Hosting
6. Your Rights (GDPR & CCPA)
  • Right of access, rectification, erasure, and portability
  • Right to withdraw consent at any time
  • MyTaxFly does not sell your personal data

Contact: privacy@mytaxfly.com — we respond within 30 days.

7. Contact
MyTaxFly — Privacyprivacy@mytaxfly.com · www.mytaxfly.com
